claim_ceiling: Finite receipt-chain validation only; no real production capability, supply sufficiency, installed-asset or service-readiness claim.

evidence_contract.matching: A receipt is satisfied only when requirement, product family, stage, owner, contract, source revision, evaluation scope, design/BOM revision and subject digest match the declared requirement profile.
evidence_contract.local_production: The evaluator always returns local_productive_capability_claim=not_assessed_by_coverage_oracle. Sourcing class is descriptive and does not establish local productive capability.

cases.description: Complete local design-to-maintenance chain.
Released design/BOM receipt is missing.
Defined process is known blocked.
Capability is merely declared, not qualified.
Capability receipt is stale.
Material lot has a known failed grade qualification.
Qualified material exists but is unavailable in the required supply window.
Delivery exists but receiving/custody acceptance is missing.
Installation receipt is bound to an older BOM revision.
Commissioning evidence is missing.
Maintenance capability is explicitly blocked.
Declared recovery requirement has no recovery receipt.
Receipt contract does not match the required stage owner contract.
Receipt source revision does not match the required owner revision.
Receipt scope digest differs from the evaluation scope.
Receipt subject digest is bound to a different product-family subject.
Revoked material evidence cannot support downstream readiness.
Disputed custody evidence remains Unknown.
A duplicate receipt identity across requirements is Unsupported.
One district has a product-family gap while another district is ready.
An imported chain is complete but does not create a local production claim.
A clinic has multiple coupled product requirements and one lacks commissioning evidence.
One source receipt is replayed for two stages.
A changed BOM revision invalidates receipts still bound to the previous revision.
